assets.alt: Three set-ups with a spring balance measuring tension T: (A) two 10 kg blocks hang on strings over pulleys at both ends of a table, joined through the balance; (B) a balance hanging from the ceiling holds a pulley with a 10 kg block on each side; (C) a 10 kg block on an incline of 30° is held by a string through a balance fixed at the top.
